turns.text: Can I share a perspective? Are you open to a different perspective? This those type of question going to create on the client side an automatic response, yes. Because no one going to say, no, I'm not open. Psychologically, when I am as a client saying yes, I'm way more open to accept whatever you are telling me now, the difference that me jumping into pitching more than telling him, yes, but look, there is this feature and this benefit and Dubai is way better and Tokyo is even more expensive.
